PM Modi Marks Partition Horrors Remembrance Day, BJP Blames Congress

On Partition Horrors Remembrance Day, Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to the victims and highlighted their resilience in rebuilding lives. He stated that survivors contributed significantly to the nation's progress. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) chief, however, blamed Congress leaders and the Nehru-Gandhi family for dividing the country for political gain and continuing to divide society. Other leaders, including from the BJP and centrist outlets, also paid tribute and called for harmony and brotherhood.
